TRANSFORMING URBAN SUSTAINABILITY

Dedicated to advancing urban sustainability through innovative consulting in Urban Building Energy Modeling (UBEM) and building decarbonization.

TwinBuilt Studio helps municipalities, building owners, campuses, and organizations pursue net-zero goals and foster more sustainable urban environments through data-driven approaches.

Our core mission is to empower clients with the tools and strategies necessary to make informed decisions for a sustainable future.

Who we serve

  • Municipalities
  • Building owners
  • Campuses and universities
  • Public organizations
  • Private organizations pursuing net-zero goals

Our approach

The practice combines engineering, artificial intelligence, digital twins, building energy analysis, and data-driven decision support. The aim is scalable solutions that facilitate smarter decision-making for cities, campuses, and buildings.
